definitions.explanation: A straight line passing through the center of a circle, connecting two points on the circumference.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{直径|ちょっけい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧10⟦センチ→センチ：01372_senchi⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: The diameter of this circle is 10 centimeters.
The diameter is twice the radius.

examples.japanese: {直径|ちょっけい}30⟦センチ→センチ：01372_senchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ピザ→ピザ：06769_piza⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{注文|ちゅうもん}した→注文する：21390_chuumon⟧。
examples.english: I ordered a pizza with a 30-centimeter diameter.

notes:
{直径|ちょっけい} is the diameter - a line passing through the center of a circle connecting two points on the edge.

WRITING:
- ⟦{直|ちょく}→直：noentry⟧: straight, direct
- ⟦{径|けい}→径：noentry⟧: path, diameter

MATHEMATICAL RELATIONSHIPS:
- {直径|ちょっけい} = ⟦{半径|はんけい}→半径：04331_hankei⟧ × 2 (diameter = radius × 2)
- ⟦{円周|えんしゅう}→円周：05442_enshuu⟧ = {直径|ちょっけい} × π (circumference = diameter × π)
- ⟦{面積|めんせき}→面積：05330_menseki⟧ = π × (⟦{半径|はんけい}→半径：04331_hankei⟧)² (area formula)

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {直径|ちょっけい}〜⟦センチ→センチ：01372_senchi⟧: ~ cm in diameter
- {直径|ちょっけい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{測|はか}る→測る：01977_hakaru⟧: to measure the diameter

RELATED GEOMETRY TERMS:
- ⟦{半径|はんけい}→半径：04331_hankei⟧: radius
- ⟦{円周|えんしゅう}→円周：05442_enshuu⟧: circumference
- ⟦{円|えん}→円：00774_en⟧: circle
- ⟦{球|きゅう}→球：noentry⟧: sphere
